_note: FROZEN rules of the author (D27 points 5-7), written only on development material (rule-development runs, pipeline check, set-up sessions, development sessions of baseline-r2, -r3 attempt and -r4); unchanged since round 3 (rule-development-log.md, round 4). Scored with scores_input.py, score.py and h5.py (D36).

claude-code/q5-start.reason: the default logs do not record whether a server was declared by the project or by the user; the only possible condition, a server name never seen before, cannot be tested here (the snapshot's history already holds earlier starts of the same server) and, made session-relative, fires at every session start for any server (adversarial review R1)

claude-code/q3-announced.class: the client records a tools/list_changed notification from an MCP server

claude-code/q3-silent.class: an MCP tool's definition stored in the transcript differs from its last earlier definition

codex/q5-start.class: right after a project-trust decision taken in the terminal UI, an MCP server whose name was never seen before is initialised (limit: other trust paths, or a server added to a repository trusted earlier, are not covered)

codex/q3-announced.class: the client records a tool-list-changed notification from an MCP server
codex/q3-announced.regex: serve_inner: (MCP server tool list changed|received notification notification=ToolListChangedNotification)

codex/q3-silent.reason: no default-log record names a tool definition, description or catalog hash; a silent change leaves no trace (development runs and set-up sessions)

gemini/q5-start.reason: no default-log record is written in the window of a repository-declared server start (2 of 2 development runs)

gemini/q3-announced.class: the chat records that an MCP server's tools were updated

gemini/q3-silent.reason: tool definitions are never stored in the default logs

qwen/q5-start.reason: only the per-session runtime.json is written, before the start and identical to normal use

qwen/q3-announced.class: an MCP tool's definition returned by the client's tool search differs from its last earlier definition (limit: only when the model calls the tool search before and after the change)

qwen/q3-silent.class: an MCP tool's definition returned by the client's tool search differs from its last earlier definition (limit: only when the model calls the tool search before and after the change)

goose/q5-start.reason: Goose does not start servers declared by a repository (no event)

goose/q3-announced.class: a tool declaration sent to the model differs from the last earlier declaration of the same tool (limit: Goose keeps only its last ten model requests; holdout windows without any request are reported)

goose/q3-silent.class: a tool declaration sent to the model differs from the last earlier declaration of the same tool (limit: Goose keeps only its last ten model requests; holdout windows without any request are reported)
